data.desc: NanoViricides, Inc. ( www.nanoviricides.com ) is a clinical stage company that is creating special purpose nanomedicines for antiviral therapy. We are at the forefronts of fighting viral diseases that have global pandemic potential, presenting unmet medical needs, and accounting for over $70 Billion in Market Size. Our first drug, a revolutionary broad-spectrum antiviral nanomedicine called NV-387 has entered Phase II clinical trial for the Treatment of the Ebola Bundibugyo Virus (BDBV) Disease (BVD, EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of September, 23, 2026. The same exact drug has also begun a Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of Mpox disease in DRC on the same date in different locations. There is no approved treatment nor vaccine for Ebola BDBV. NV-387 is the only Oral Treatment in clinical trials for Ebola to the best of our knowledge. As such, it can be an important tool for combatting not just BDBV but any future Ebola viruses, if successful.
